prose: The Wall Street Journal reports that Brookings projects US AI spending to total $10.3T between 2025 and 2032 - averaging 3.6% of GDP per year - the largest single-industry build-out as a share of the economy on record. The article is paywalled, so this summary is based on the headline and lead captured by the feed.
highlights: Brookings: US AI spending of $10.3T projected for 2025-2032
Largest single-industry build-out as a GDP share on record
Paywalled - summary based on headline and lead
